reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly supports the formation of an HfZr transition layer via Zr diffusion into a Hf coating on VZrHfNbTa, but it provides no data on oxidation reduction, oxygen barrier effectiveness, or the claimed 40-50% improvement, leaving the key performance premises unsupported.
premises: Zirconium diffuses from the HEA substrate into the hafnium coating during high-temperature exposure
The diffusion of Zr into Hf forms an HfZr alloy transition layer
The HfZr transition layer acts as an effective oxygen barrier
The oxygen barrier reduces high-temperature oxidation and surface defects
The reduction in oxidation is approximately 40-50% compared to untreated baseline
